scope: Proposition 9.1 (Simultaneous dimension and marked-hook estimates) of the manuscript “Signed tensor densities and diagram budgets for the Thorp shuffle” (preprints/Signed-tensor-densities-and-diagram-budgets-for-coordinate-sweeps-September-26-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 238 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 69f29b044ee825ef), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 62. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There are an absolute threshold D and, after D is fixed, an absolute power of two p ≥ 1 such that the following bounds hold at every level l ≥ 0 and every size n = 2d with 1 ≤ d ≤ 2lD. For every λ ⊢ n with positive trace, (G) holds. For every such λ and every µ ⊆ λ with µKn+1 ≤ Kn, put t = n − |µ|. If t > 0 and log(n/t) ≤ u log n, then (H) holds: (G) eλ ≤ AlBλ, (H) eλ + J(t, n) ≤ AlBµ + blW(t, n). (87)
